summary: Require compatible acquired drills for wet mining and fluid resource sources.
details: Resource extraction that consumes or produces fluid requires an independently acquired compatible mining drill. Native category, positive speed, fluid-box filters and item-output declarations constrain admission; dry sources and independent alternatives remain eligible.

Drill acquisition and mining-input research gates survive into lab and science progression. Unseeded placement/input cycles cannot create an initial source, and actual recipe replacement invalidates warm actor acquisition. Stable technology and ownership identities remain unchanged.

Controlled lab, researchability and source-epoch consumers exercise these decisions. Installed field/declaration readback is not engine execution. Current-package production, native placement, power, fluid delivery, catalogue preservation and saved-world acceptance remain unqualified.

target_dispositions.reason: Shared resource-extraction acquisition guard; wet-mining fields follow the target adapter. Controlled checks do not qualify native production, catalogue or saved-world behavior.
